source.headObservation: Head matched the pinned commit during this review; this document is not a latest-head claim.

policy: No apps/CLI source is copied or modified by this proposal.
The four portfolio wrapper files form a minimal logical seam, not a dependency-complete standalone patch.
S0/WP10 must resolve direct imports against the selected composition before materializing exact blobs.
Do not replace a modified consumer blob or import the whole owner branch to satisfy this proposal.
No native/session/skill/consumer proof is declared by source inspection or previous-owner test names.

entries.purpose: Verified-call callback captures exact authority.native.operationIdentity; captureCurrent and locked run publication preserve private run/session/generation/record binding.
Bridge verifies the bound receipt and host authority, invokes onVerifiedCall before finishing its lease.
Read ready provenance from protected C08; running capture must match current private bridge capture. Prevent arbitrary preference publication.
Publish AlternativeDraft only with a private capture and final locked revalidation; atomically persist run, output and provenance.
Read the existing parent receipt before resolving mutable candidates; validate parent+child digests and issue a temporary private exact-child grant.
Supply handoff.parent, handoff.authorize and handoff.verify to the WP11 mutation service.
Wrap http.prepare/promote and contribution.prepareChoice/promoteAlternative in handoff.run with mutations.replayPortfolio.
Admit exact human intent and allow historical retry on portfolio prepare/promote before the wrapper resolves its existing receipt.
Published test of canonical parent receipt replay; original receipt is manually seeded in C08.
Published actual HTTP promotion, historical choice, source/authority fence and idempotency assertions.
Published native authority/private-publication guard tests; no actual model execution inferred.

requirements: portfolioParent must return the exact human parent only for its producer-derived child.
Saved transaction value retains portfolioReplay.parentDigest and child; commandDigest binds the child.
Replay reads current case authority and verifies saved result/receipt without resolving changed candidates.
captureAlternativeProvenance is called from the verified native bridge with exact host operationIdentity, not a model-supplied value.
Read-only validation alone cannot confer private publication authority.
Replay the persisted request through the actual producer and current evidence; do not register another coverage record.
Compare the complete output digest to the captured receipt and preserve case/version/source binding.

negativeTestsRequired.case: Real parent effect commits and response is lost; same human parent and correlation return the original receipt after case version advances.
assert: no new portfolio evaluation/candidate resolution on receipt replay
one domain effect, unchanged number of result/receipt records

negativeTestsRequired.case: Same operation identity with changed parent, child, target incarnation or child digest.
Fresh UI context with direct child, read-only grant, revoked grant or missing private parent capture.
assert: no writable authority is inherited from a transport

negativeTestsRequired.case: Exact native call capture versus wrong operationIdentity/callId/session/generation/provider binding.
assert: only exact live private capture can publish
no contribution or provenance write on mismatched capture

negativeTestsRequired.case: Reopen saved AlternativeDraft and current-choice review; sources, membership or source incarnation change.
assert: actual read-only replay rejects stale/unavailable evidence
no synthetic human or loaded-skill proof

observedFindings.finding: Seed WP11 exposes replayPortfolio without an apps caller; the pinned WP10 composition already supplies parent-aware wrappers before mutable candidate evaluation.
observedFindings.action: Consume the published wrapper seam; avoid duplicating it inside foreign portfolio domain code.

observedFindings.finding: WP11 provenance helper only requires nonempty operationIdentity, but the actual producer supplies it from a consumed private lease and the publication fence matches the exact private capture.
observedFindings.action: Keep the exact host chain and add hosted discriminating witnesses; do not report helper isolation as a proven production bypass.
